blurb: Cole is a retail options trader who describes himself as a momentum options trader focused on swings, LEAPs, and options selling. He runs @StockOptionCole as a personal trading journal, posting weekly analysis on SPY/SPX and QQQ, daily alerts recaps, and educational threads on options terminology and strategy. He also operates a community group where he shares trade alerts and resources.
credibility_note: Self-described retail trader; all posts carry a 'not financial advice' disclaimer. No verified institutional background or audited track record found in the available sources.
